elevation.instances_note: the game instance and the launcher instance it returns to
elevation.proof: the client's own write/read/compare of /data/.lapy_probe_<pid> passed; the launcher then listed /data/ps5proton/games (8 entries)

daemon.sdk: ps5-payload-sdk v0.40 release (zip sha256 617fb702df3551f709b2db0a014e618cf39334c9348395a9b005e6504d076a42); the last release whose kernel_get_ucred_attrs still returns uint64_t, which is what this daemon calls

title.change: the /data request is made before platform_init, so the process is single-threaded when the daemon inspects it

open: not clean: two payload processes (the daemon's donor children, released when the elevated game instance exec'd) faulted in user mode (SIGSEGV, fault address 0x1b0) and were coredumped during this run; upstream records the same signature for firmware it has not validated (its 6.02 note: donor processes faulted in user mode, every cycle functionally correct). The captures of the legacy path on 2026-10-04 show no fatal signals at all

the daemon's own ps5log events (daemon_start, target_state, target_preflight, reference counters) were not captured: this host is not reachable from the console, so dev.conf points at a console-local listener only to satisfy the daemon's logging gate
the root reference balance after these two elevations is therefore still unmeasured on 10.01
